title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
abstract: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.18399v1 的 32 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：promised。
analysis.ideaZh: Bifocal 将 visual token budget 分给 query-focused 细证据、image-intrinsic 覆盖证据与 pooled coarse context，再在 LLM 内按 density-adjusted attention 剪枝。作者报告普通 VQA 保真可能掩盖 grounding 崩溃，而混合 granularity 更平衡；最激进 budget 下 grounding 仍丢失约三分之一，不是无损压缩。
analysis.motivationZh: visual token pruning 在普通 VQA 保留高分时仍可能严重破坏 OCR 和 grounding，因为单一 ranking 丢失互补证据和空间完整性。
analysis.methodZh: Bifocal 将 visual token budget 分给 query-focused 细证据、image-intrinsic 覆盖证据与 pooled coarse context，再在 LLM 内按 density-adjusted attention 剪枝。作者报告普通 VQA 保真可能掩盖 grounding 崩溃，而混合 granularity 更平衡；最激进 budget 下 grounding 仍丢失约三分之一，不是无损压缩。
methodFlow: word / patch saliency 软 AND 与 norm-debiased image saliency 找 query evidence
greedy submodular coverage 保留 image-intrinsic 细证据
剩余 patches 合为 coarse context
native / pooled tokens 以位置进入 LLM
analysis.experimentsZh: 三 MLLM families、九 model / budget settings，14 benchmarks 覆盖 general/reasoning/OCR/hallucination/grounding，按 layer-averaged budget 匹配。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 Qwen2.5-VL7B 在 25%tokens 时 general relative94.9%、grounding90.2%；15%时分别 89.0%、67.9%。LLaVA1.5 的 128-token grounding 相对 base101.8%。（Tables 2-3, p. 11） 对照范围：比较 10 种 pruners，包括 FastV、VisionZip、DART、Nüwa、HiPrune、EADP 等；不应用 general average 代替 fine-grained grounding 结果。 消融与诊断：Table4 分 coarse、intrinsic、query allocation，full 并非所有单指标最佳；混合配置在能力组间取平衡。
analysis.insightZh: 贡献不仅是新 ranking：承认互补证据与空间完整性，显式混合 fine/coarse token types；无需新增训练。
analysis.evidenceZh: word weighting 结合 image saliency，并以 geometric mean 实现 soft conjunction。（Sec. 3.1, pp. 7-8; Fig. 4, p. 7）；coverage greedy selection 与 nonselectedpatch pooling 分工，每 patch native 保留或进入一个 coarsetoken。（Secs. 3.2-3.4, pp. 8-9）；作者报告 Qwen2.5-VL7B 在 25%tokens 时 general relative94.9%、grounding90.2%；15%时分别 89.0%、67.9%。LLaVA1.5 的 128-token grounding 相对 base101.8%。（Tables 2-3, p. 11）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 多粒度 visualrepresentation 与细粒度 grounding 保真直接属于 VLM tokenization / grounding 方法。
analysis.caveatZh: 未见独立 limitations section；低 budget 对 OCR / grounding 仍有显著损失，平均分隐藏个例风险。；PDF 声称 GitHub code available，但本轮仓库 API404，未确认可公开实现，Code 按 promised 记录。；静态 image 证据不说明 multi-image / video 或设计 agent 长期观察的性能。
